en.headline: Chloe Leung takes Asian Games road race bronze for Hong Kong
en.dek: The cyclist finished third in the women’s individual road race in Nagoya, 41 seconds behind the leaders, after a fourth-place time-trial result two days earlier.
body: Hong Kong cyclist Chloe Leung Wing-yee claimed bronze in the women’s individual road race at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Tuesday, finishing in 2 hours 50 minutes 46 seconds.

She crossed the line 41 seconds behind China’s Guo Li and Afghanistan’s Fariba Hashimi, who took gold and silver. Riding in a pack of about 40, Leung stayed with the main group early on and moved into the leading group on the third lap before being dropped by the two leaders on a descent.

The medal came two days after she finished fourth in the individual time trial. Leung said she had been unhappy with that result and wanted to give everything with no regrets. The bronze will attract HK$250,000 under the Jockey Club Athlete Incentive Awards Scheme.

zh.headline: 梁穎儀亞運公路賽摘銅 港隊今屆首面單車獎牌
zh.dek: 梁穎儀在名古屋女子個人公路賽以2小時50分46秒奪銅，落後冠亞軍41秒，兩日前計時賽排第四。
body: 香港單車運動員梁穎儀周二在愛知·名古屋亞運會女子個人公路賽奪得銅牌，成績為2小時50分46秒。
她落後中國選手郭麗及阿富汗選手法里芭·哈希米41秒。比賽約有40人參賽，梁穎儀早段跟隨大集團，第三圈加入領先集團，但在落斜時被兩名領先者拋離。
這枚獎牌是她兩日前在個人計時賽取得第四名之後奪得。梁穎儀表示對計時賽表現感到不滿，今場希望全力以赴不留遺憾。這枚銅牌可獲賽馬會精英運動員獎勵計劃25萬港元獎金。
